title: Work IQ: human in the loop for agents and agent flows
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, documented control paths and consumption licensing are supported. Searches did not locate documentation for the planned Work IQ approval mechanism, and the briefing correctly distinguishes it from existing tool confirmation and reports the conflicting write-operation defaults.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Work IQ uses consumption billing, supporting the consumption licensing model.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses consumption billing. A separate spending policy isn't required for Work IQ.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes and cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Work IQ consumption is measured in Copilot Credits, supporting the variable cost rating.
claims.quote: Work IQ in Copilot Studio is powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness, which uses Copilot Credits for usage-based billing.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: An additional charge specific to Work IQ pauses or approvals is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ Copilot Credits billing pause approval human in loop charge rate. Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio and Overview of usage-based billing; read billing search excerpts. General consumption billing is documented, but no separate pause or approval charge was found.

claims.claim: The tenant Work IQ MCP policy is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center through Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools. In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP. On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.claim: An API equivalent for turning tenant Work IQ MCP policy on or off is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" MCP policy settings Microsoft Graph API update Allowed Disallowed; "Work IQ" "policy" "graph" "PATCH". Opened Policy governance for Work IQ MCP. Its configuration discussion and search results gave no operation and setting property for this control.

claims.claim: The MCP policy governance article says mutation operations, including sending email, are not allowed by default.
claims.quote: By default, mutation operations aren't allowed for safety. This restriction includes create, update, delete, and action requests that modify data, such as sending email.

claims.claim: The Work IQ in Copilot Studio article says write operations are on by default.
claims.quote: Write operations are on by default. Your organization's permissions and policies still apply.

claims.claim: The maker tool-confirmation setting is reached through Agents > agent > Tools > tool > Details > Ask the end user before running in Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: In Copilot Studio, select Agents, and then select your agent. Go to the agent's Tools page. To view or change a tool's settings, go to your agent's Tools page and select the tool. The configuration page has three sections: Details, Inputs, and Completion.

claims.claim: An API operation that sets Ask the end user before running is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio "Ask the end user before running" API Dataverse botcomponent confirmation central policy. Opened Add tools to custom agents; searched the botcomponent table reference for confirm, approval and ask. Generic content updates did not document this setting's property or schema.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio documents a maker-configured, per-tool setting that asks the end user to confirm before the tool runs.
claims.quote: Ask the end user before running | Asks the user to confirm before the tool runs. Set to No by default.

claims.claim: The cited Copilot Studio tool configuration documentation applies to agents using the standard harness.
claims.quote: This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: A tenant human-in-the-loop policy specifically for Work IQ agents and agent flows is not yet documented on either UI or API surfaces.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human in the loop"; "Work IQ" "human" "approval" default policy approver timeout; "Work IQ" "policy" "graph" "PATCH". Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio and Policy governance for Work IQ MCP; neither documented an approval policy for the planned capability.

claims.claim: No central policy requiring the existing Copilot Studio per-tool confirmation setting was found as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio "Ask the end user before running" API Dataverse botcomponent confirmation central policy. Opened Add tools to custom agents; read security and data-policy search excerpts. They described tool restrictions, not a policy requiring this confirmation setting.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not clarified whether the planned pause is maker-configured, enforced by admin policy, or both.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human" "approval" default policy approver timeout; "Work IQ" "human in the loop". Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio and Policy governance for Work IQ MCP; no configuration or enforcement mechanism for the roadmap pause was found.
